description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes for handling git pathspecs, including compilation, matching against working directory, index, tree, and diff, as well as managing match lists and failure tracking.

methods.name: git_pathspec_new
methods.description: Compile a pathspec from a list of paths.

methods.name: git_pathspec_matches_path
methods.description: Check if a path matches a compiled pathspec with specific flags.

methods.name: git_pathspec_match_workdir
methods.description: Match a pathspec against the working directory of a repository.

methods.name: git_pathspec_match_index
methods.description: Match a pathspec against the repository index.

methods.name: git_pathspec_match_tree
methods.description: Match a pathspec against files in a tree object.

methods.name: git_pathspec_match_diff
methods.description: Match a pathspec against files in a diff list.

methods.name: git_pathspec_match_list_entrycount
methods.description: Get the number of matched entries.

methods.name: git_pathspec_match_list_entry
methods.description: Retrieve a matched filename by index.

methods.name: git_pathspec_match_list_diff_entry
methods.description: Retrieve a diff delta by index.

methods.name: git_pathspec_match_list_failed_entrycount
methods.description: Get the number of pathspec items that failed to match.

methods.name: git_pathspec_match_list_failed_entry
methods.description: Retrieve a pathspec pattern that had no matches.
